# WanVaceAdvanced Example Workflow v1.0

## Required Node Packs
- [ComfyUI-WanVaceAdvanced](https://github.com/drozbay/ComfyUI-WanVaceAdvanced)  
- [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes)  
- [ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite](https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite)

## Models:
- **Phantom 14b**: [Phantom-Wan-14B_fp16](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/WanVideo_comfy/blob/main/Phantom-Wan-14B_fp16.safetensors)
- **Vace Module bf16**: [Wan2_1-VACE_module_14B_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/WanVideo_comfy/blob/main/Wan2_1-VACE_module_14B_bf16.safetensors)
- **or Vace Module fp8**: [Wan2_1-VACE_module_14B_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/WanVideo_comfy/blob/main/Wan2_1-VACE_module_14B_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors)

## Optional:
- **2.2 A14B Low Noise LoRA**: [Wan22_A14B_T2V_lora_extract_r64.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/drozbay/Wan2.2_A14B_lora_extract/blob/main/Wan22_A14B_T2V_lora_extract_r64.safetensors)
- **CausVid Lora**: [Wan21_CausVid_14B_T2V_lora_rank32_v2.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/WanVideo_comfy/blob/main/Wan21_CausVid_14B_T2V_lora_rank32_v2.safetensors)

You can also use the VACE+Phantom merged models provided by InnerReflections instead of using the Module:
- **Vace+Phantom Merge:** [Wan2.1_VACE_Phantom](https://huggingface.co/Inner-Reflections/Wan2.1_VACE_Phantom/tree/main)
